key_concepts: Sex-linked traits are inherited through X chromosomes.
Males have only one X chromosome, so X-linked recessive traits are expressed.
Females can be carriers of X-linked recessive traits without being affected.
Hemophilia and color blindness are X-linked recessive traits in humans.
Sex-limited traits are autosomal and expressed exclusively in one sex.
Milk production in females and scrotal circumference in males are sex-limited traits.
Sex-influenced traits are autosomal and expressed in both sexes but more frequently in one
Pattern baldness is a sex-influenced trait influenced by testosterone.
DNA is deoxyribonucleic acid and contains instructions for making proteins.
DNA has a double helix structure discovered by Watson and Crick with Franklin's X-ray evid
DNA nucleotides consist of deoxyribose sugar, phosphate group, and nitrogenous base.
Adenine pairs with thymine and guanine pairs with cytosine.
